description: Payees: publish the payment instructions buyers should use, so instructions arriving by email can be confirmed — declare (an XRPL address and tag, or a bank account by salted digest: the number is never published), endorsed from your own wallet; list, revoke at once, or record an anchor signed elsewhere. New instructions are in force after a 72-hour cooling period. Moves money: on mainnet pass yes=true only after the person you act for agrees.

account.description: declare a bank account: account number or IBAN (hashed here, never sent).

address.description: declare: the XRPL address you are paid at.

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

days.description: declare: valid for this many days (default: until revoked or replaced).

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

hint.description: declare a bank account: what buyers see, e.g. "First Bank ••4321" (at most four digits).

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

purpose.description: declare: display text, e.g. "Land purchase, Block 12 Lot 3".

replaces.description: declare: comma-separated ids of your earlier instructions this replaces.

routing.description: declare a bank account: routing number / sort code / BIC (hashed here, never sent).

tag.description: declare: the destination tag buyers must use (e.g. at an exchange).

tx.description: anchor: hash of an endorsement signed from another wallet (your profile wallet, or the declared address). Without it, this tool's wallet endorses when it is your profile wallet.

name: market_payee
